fields.label: Header Type
fields.name: page_header_type
fields.instructions: Select which type of header to use for the page with the featured image: box width or full width

fields.label: Header Style
fields.name: page_header_style
fields.instructions:
Enter CSS Style to affect the header if different from the default. 
Example: height: 600px;

fields.label: Breadcrumbs Level
fields.name: page_breadcrumbs_level
fields.instructions: Enter a number such as 0, 1 or 2 to indicate how many levels of breadcrumbs to show for this page. The default is 2: top level plus page level. 0 means hide the breadcrumbs and top bar

fields.label: Breadcrumb
fields.name: page_breadcrumb
fields.instructions: Enter the top-level Breadcrumb for this page

fields.label: Title Font
fields.name: page_title_font
fields.instructions: Enter a Google Font name to be used for the title font instead of the default. Find fonts here: https://fonts.google.com/ Examples: Rock Salt  Architects Daughter

fields.label: Title Font Size
fields.name: page_title_font_size
fields.instructions: Enter the font size and unit for the title font. Example: 40px

sub_fields.label: Video Embed Code
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_video
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the video embed code here

sub_fields.label: Post Expand
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_post_expand
sub_fields.instructions: Expand the content: yes - or Show all content: no

sub_fields.label: Open Asset Album
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_openasset_album
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the Open Asset Album ID

sub_fields.label: Carousel Autoplay
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_autoplay
sub_fields.instructions: Leave blank to not autoplay. Enter a number of milliseconds to indicate autoplay duration. 3000 = 3 seconds between slides.

sub_fields.label: Carousel Zoom
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_carousel_zoom
sub_fields.instructions: Enter a number such as 1.2 to represent how much the carousel images zoom when moused over. 1 is no zoom. 2 would be huge. 0.5 would shrink

sub_fields.label: Album Order
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_album_order
sub_fields.instructions: This is the field to order the album by from OpenAsset. Default: display_order, original_filename

sub_fields.label: YouTube ID
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_youtube_id
sub_fields.instructions: Put just the YouTube ID of the video to embed here

sub_fields.label: Font Family
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_font_family
sub_fields.instructions: Find a font on https://fonts.google.com/ and enter the name here. Examples: Caprasimo  Kablammo Bungee

sub_fields.label: Font Size
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_font_size
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the font size including the units. Example: 24px  30pt

sub_fields.label: Font Color
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_font_color
sub_fields.instructions: Enter a CSS color for the header font. Here is a list of color names which can be used - or hex values can also be used. https://www.w3docs.com/learn-css/css-color-names.html  examples: Teal  Magenta  MediumBlue #000  (black) #FFF (white)

sub_fields.label: Buttons per Row
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_buttons_per_row
sub_fields.instructions: How many buttons per row? 1,2,3,4,5 or 6

sub_fields.label: Buttons Style
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_buttonsstyle
sub_fields.instructions:
This CSS style will be applied to the buttons in this section. Example: 
text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;

sub_fields.label: Button Link Target
sub_fields.name: module_button_link_target
sub_fields.instructions: select new tab or same window for button link

sub_fields.label: Button Foreground Color
sub_fields.name: module_button_color
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the color as a CSS color. Ex blue green teal #333 #000 #57F83E #FF00FF. Defaults to #FFF

sub_fields.label: Button Background Color
sub_fields.name: module_button_bgcolor
sub_fields.instructions: Enter the color as a CSS color. Ex blue green teal #333 #000 #57F83E #FF00FF. Defaults to #DDD

sub_fields.label: Button Image
sub_fields.name: module_button_image
sub_fields.instructions: Add an image to take the place of the top content

sub_fields.label: Divider
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_divider
sub_fields.instructions: Add a divider above this section?

sub_fields.label: Section Style
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_style

sub_fields.label: Section Class
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_section_class
sub_fields.instructions: List any classes to apply to the style - separated by spaces. Ex: fancylink to add the site link treatment. combined to combine sections such as with authors. Combine sections width can be customized in the Sections Style such as width:500px;

sub_fields.label: Featured Image Style
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_image_style
sub_fields.instructions: CSS to be applied to the feature image. Ex: background-position:top;  or background-position:center;   etc

sub_fields.label: Author Name
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_authorname
sub_fields.instructions: When using Team Member all fields will populate automatically from OpenAsset. OpenAsset data can be overridden by filling in a field. To leave a field blank enter a space.

sub_fields.label: In The News Number to Show
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_inthenewsnumber
sub_fields.instructions: Default to All

sub_fields.label: In The News Posts Per Page
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_inthenewspostsperpage
sub_fields.instructions: Default to All

sub_fields.label: In The News Columns
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_inthenewscols
sub_fields.instructions: Default to 3

sub_fields.label: In The News Project Categories
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_inthenewscat
sub_fields.instructions: Default to All

sub_fields.label: In the News Project Tags
sub_fields.name: module_repeater_inthenewstags
sub_fields.instructions: Default to All
